notes.title: Graphics Option Patch
notes.content:
Hello all,

Thank you to everyone who has played and supported this game!

We have an update here containing some options that can help optimize Perfect Vermin which we think will help a lot of users who have trouble running the game.

[b]Changes[/b]
      [list]
      [*] Added 3D resolution, anti aliasing, post processing quality, shadow quality, texture quality, and 
           effect quality graphic options.
      [*] Updated credits.
      [/list]

notes.title: Brutal Orchestra Coming Soon + Swallow the Sea on Steam!
notes.content:
Today is a very big day for us!

[h1][b]Brutal Orchestra[/b] a new game from the artist and designer that brought you Perfect Vermin
[/h1]

[previewyoutube=0P4h23qz1-E;full][previewyoutube=0P4h23qz1-E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[/previewyoutube]

Brutal Orchestra is a Turn-Based Roguelike Strategy game with resource management and deck-building elements. Employ the help of damaged and daring fools, equip ancient and insidious items and make deals with the devil on your path to revenge

We will have much more to share about Brutal Orchestra in the coming weeks. If you want to get a sneak peak early we know have an [url=https://discord.gg/b6Gm7ctKcX]official discord server[/url] for Brutal Orchestra and all the other games I have worked on: https://discord.gg/b6Gm7ctKcX

[h1][b]Swallow the Sea is available on Steam right now![/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1511860/Swallow_the_Sea

This release comes with a quality of life update for Swallow the Sea!

This update adds:

-Steam achievements
-Controller and keyboard support.
-An improved pause menu.
-A toggleable in-game timer (for speed-running or just for fun.)
-Numerous feature improvements.

Keep an eye out we have so much more to share very very soon.
